provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: Clean water and diseases
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state where germs hide.
The pupils should be able to explain why we wash before eating.

Introduction:
We learn about clean water today. Last week we talked about keeping our bodies clean.

Content:
Germs hide in dirty water. Germs also hide on our hands. Dirty water makes us sick. We must drink clean water. Wash your hands with soap before eating food. This keeps germs away.

Class activity:
Let us pretend to wash our hands. Show me how you wash your hands before eating.

Evaluation questions:
Where do germs hide?
Why should we wash before eating?
What happens if we drink dirty water?

Summary:
Clean water keeps us healthy. Washing hands removes germs.

topics.title: Air around us
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify moving air.
The pupils should be able to explain what wind is.

Introduction:
Today we learn about air. We breathe air every day.

Content:
Air is all around us. We cannot see air but we can feel it. Moving air is called wind. Wind can be strong or gentle. When we blow air, we feel it on our face.

Class activity:
Let us blow air on our hands. Feel the air moving. Now wave your hand in the air. Do you feel the wind?

Evaluation questions:
What is moving air called?
Can we see air?
How do we feel air?

Summary:
Air is all around us. Wind is moving air.

topics.title: Things that float and sink
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify objects that float.
The pupils should be able to identify objects that sink.

Introduction:
Today we learn about floating and sinking. We see this when we bathe.

Content:
Some things float on water. Other things sink in water. A stone sinks in water. A leaf floats on water. Heavy things usually sink. Light things usually float.

Class activity:
Let us put different objects in a bowl of water. Which objects float? Which objects sink?

Evaluation questions:
What happens to a stone in water?
What happens to a leaf in water?
Why do some things float and others sink?

Summary:
Some things float on water. Other things sink in water.

topics.title: Colours around us
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to name basic colours.
The pupils should be able to sort objects by colour.

Introduction:
Today we learn about colours. We see colours everywhere.

Content:
Colours are all around us. The common colours are red, blue, yellow, green, and brown. A ripe tomato is red. A leaf is green. The sky is blue.

Class activity:
Let us name colours in our classroom. Now let us sort our crayons by colour.

Evaluation questions:
What colour is a ripe tomato?
What colour is a leaf?
Name three colours you see in the classroom.

Summary:
Colours make our world beautiful. We can sort things by colour.

topics.title: Sound around us
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify loud sounds.
The pupils should be able to identify soft sounds.

Introduction:
Today we learn about sounds. We hear sounds every day.

Content:
Sound is what we hear. Some sounds are loud. Some sounds are soft. A drum makes a loud sound. A whisper makes a soft sound. Animals make sounds too.

Class activity:
Let us make loud sounds. Now let us make soft sounds. Which sound did you like more?

Evaluation questions:
What is sound?
Give an example of a loud sound.
Give an example of a soft sound.

Summary:
Sounds can be loud or soft. We enjoy different sounds.

topics.title: Growing a simple plant
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to describe how a plant grows.
The pupils should be able to name things plants need to grow.

Introduction:
Today we learn about growing plants. Plants are living things.

Content:
Plants need water to grow. Plants need sunlight to grow. Let us grow beans in cotton. Put beans on wet cotton. Watch the beans sprout and grow roots.

Class activity:
Let us put beans on wet cotton. We will water them every day. We will watch them grow.

Evaluation questions:
What do plants need to grow?
What will happen to beans on wet cotton?
Why do plants need sunlight?

Summary:
Plants need water and sunlight to grow. We can watch plants grow.

topics.title: Insects around us
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to name common insects.
The pupils should be able to describe where insects live.

Introduction:
Today we learn about insects. Insects are small animals.

Content:
Common insects are butterflies, bees, and ants. Butterflies have colourful wings. Bees make honey. Ants work together. Insects live in gardens, trees, and on the ground.

Class activity:
Let us look at pictures of insects. Can you name each insect? Where does each insect live?

Evaluation questions:
Name three common insects.
What do bees make?
Where do ants live?

Summary:
Insects are small animals. They live in many places.

topics.title: Energy: the sun
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state what the sun gives us.
The pupils should be able to explain why the sun is important.

Introduction:
Today we learn about the sun. The sun is a big star.

Content:
The sun gives us light. The sun gives us warmth. The sun helps plants grow. Plants need sunlight to make food. Without the sun, we would be cold and dark.

Class activity:
Let us feel the warmth of the sun. Close your eyes and feel the light. How does the sun make you feel?

Evaluation questions:
What does the sun give us?
Why do plants need the sun?
What would happen without the sun?

Summary:
The sun gives us light and warmth. The sun helps plants grow.

topics.title: Simple tools
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to name simple tools.
The pupils should be able to state the uses of simple tools.

Introduction:
Today we learn about tools. Tools help us do work.

Content:
Simple tools are spoon, cup, and hoe. A spoon helps us eat. A cup helps us drink water. A hoe helps us dig the ground. Farmers use hoes to farm.

Class activity:
Let us pretend to use a spoon to eat. Now let us pretend to use a hoe to dig.

Evaluation questions:
Name three simple tools.
What is a spoon used for?
What is a hoe used for?

Summary:
Tools help us do work. Each tool has a special use.

topics.title: Revision and assessment
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to recall what we learned this year.
The pupils should be able to answer questions about our topics.

Introduction:
Today we revise what we learned this year. We will have a fun quiz.

Content:
We learned about clean water, air, floating and sinking, colours, sound, plants, insects, the sun, and tools. Let us remember what we learned about each topic.

Class activity:
Let us play a game. I will ask questions and you will raise your hand to answer.

Evaluation questions:
What makes us sick?
What is moving air called?
What do plants need to grow?
Name a colour you like.

Summary:
We learned many things this year. Science is all around us.
